# I18n Checklist: Production-Ready Boilerplate

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements-quality of the multi-language (i18n) requirements in the spec - English base + French now - for completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of what is WRITTEN, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [tasks.md](../tasks.md) | [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are i18n requirements defined for EVERY user-facing surface (pages, forms, dialogs, header, footer, auth screens, dashboard, command palette, cookie banner)? [Completeness, Spec §US3, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements specified for localizing transactional emails (verification, reset, security notifications)? [Gap, Completeness]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are date, number, and pluralization formatting requirements defined (English/French locale-aware)? [Gap, Completeness]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements specified for the language switcher placement and behavior (signed-in users only)? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the browser-locale detection requirement defined for signed-out visitors with an explicit fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for how a NEW language is added (file + registration, no code changes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the v1 language set explicitly specified (English base + French)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "immediately" for language switching quantified (time bound or "no full reload")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the locale resolution order unambiguous (saved preference > browser locale > English fallback)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the fallback behavior for missing translation keys explicitly defined (fall back to English, never raw keys)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "user-facing string" defined with clear boundaries (UI only, server errors stay English)? [Clarity, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the language-persistence mechanism specified (cookie for visitors, user field for signed-in)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, data-model.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Do the i18n requirements align between User Story 3, FR-010 to FR-013, FR-025, and the clarified scope (full incl. formatting)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does the language-field design stay consistent between `convex/auth.ts` additionalFields and the component user schema? [Consistency, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are date/number formatting requirements consistent with next-intl's capabilities (research decision)? [Consistency, research.md §1]
- [ ] CHK016 - Does the RTL exclusion conflict with any stated i18n requirement? [Consistency, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Can SC-002 (100% of strings translatable) be objectively verified? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-003 (language switch reflects immediately) be verified without implementation knowledge? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is there a measurable acceptance criterion for fallback correctness (missing keys never rendered)? [Gap, Measurability]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for the signed-out visitor scenario (browser locale, no persisted choice)? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for the signed-in switcher scenario (choice persisted across visits)? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for an unsupported browser locale (e.g. `de` when only `en`/`fr` ship)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for a user switching language mid-session (no reload required)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for localized error messages in forms (UI-level validation localized)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Is the empty-message-file scenario addressed (language registered but file empty)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the missing-key scenario addressed for every UI surface (pages, forms, dialogs, emails)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the RTL-language addition scenario documented as deferred? [Edge Case, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the mixed-locale scenario addressed (user saved `fr`, browser sends `en`)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are pluralization edge cases addressed (0, 1, many in both languages)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 - Are performance requirements defined for language switching (no full reload, responsive)? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are accessibility requirements defined for the language switcher (keyboard, screen-reader labels)? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are SEO/metadata requirements defined for localized content (title/description per locale)? [Gap, NFR]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the next-intl dependency decision documented with its implications (plugin, request config, provider)? [Dependency, research.md §1]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the RTL deferral recorded as an explicit assumption? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the server-error-stays-English decision recorded as an explicit assumption? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the cookie-based locale contract documented (name, payload, scope)? [Dependency, contracts/feature-toggles.md]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 - Is "all user-facing strings" free of ambiguity (explicit surface list)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK038 - Does the spec resolve whether OAuth provider names / external content are translated? [Conflict/Ambiguity, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
